verses.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח חִירָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צ֤וֹר אֶת־ עֲבָדָיו֙ אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י אֹת֛וֹ מָשְׁח֥וּ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑יהוּ כִּ֣י אֹהֵ֗ב הָיָ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לְדָוִ֖ד כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥî·rām me·leḵ- ṣō·wr ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw ’el- šə·lō·mōh kî šā·ma‘ kî ’ō·ṯōw mā·šə·ḥū lə·me·leḵ ta·ḥaṯ ’ā·ḇî·hū kî ’ō·hêḇ hā·yāh ḥî·rām lə·ḏā·wiḏ kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Now when Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king in his father’s place he sent envoys to Solomon for Hiram had always . . . been a friend of David
verses.literalPt: E ENVIOU Hirão, rei de Tiro, os seus servos a Salomão (porque ouvira que ungiram a Salomão rei em lugar de seu pai), porquanto Hirão sempre tinha amado a Davi.

verses.literal: And Solomon relayed this message to Hiram
verses.literalPt: Então Salomão mandou dizer a Hirão:

verses.original: אַתָּ֨ה יָדַ֜עְתָּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֗י כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָכֹל֙ לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֗יִת לְשֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו מִפְּנֵ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבָבֻ֑הוּ עַ֤ד תֵּת־ יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֥וֹת רַגְלוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî kî lō yā·ḵōl liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw mip·pə·nê ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’ă·šer sə·ḇā·ḇu·hū ‘aḏ têṯ- Yah·weh ’ō·ṯām ta·ḥaṯ kap·pō·wṯ raḡ·lō
verses.literal: As you are well aware due to the wars waged on all sides against my father David he could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD had put his enemies under his feet . . .
verses.literalPt: Bem sabes tu que Davi, meu pai, não pôde edificar uma casa ao nome do SENHOR seu Deus, por causa da guerra com que o cercaram, até que o SENHOR pôs seus inimigos debaixo das plantas dos seus pés.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛י לִ֖י מִסָּבִ֑יב אֵ֣ין שָׂטָ֔ן וְאֵ֖ין פֶּ֥גַע רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hê·nî·aḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hay lî mis·sā·ḇîḇ ’ên śā·ṭān wə·’ên pe·ḡa‘ rā‘
verses.literal: But now the LORD my God . . . has given me rest on every side and there is no adversary . . . or crisis . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém agora o SENHOR meu Deus me tem dado descanso de todos os lados; adversário não há, nem algum mau encontro.

verses.original: וְהִנְנִ֣י אֹמֵ֔ר לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ דָּוִ֤ד אָבִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בִּנְךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֶתֵּ֤ן תַּחְתֶּ֙יךָ֙ עַל־ כִּסְאֶ֔ךָ הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֥ה הַבַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nî ’ō·mêr liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’el- dā·wiḏ ’ā·ḇî lê·mōr bin·ḵā ’ă·šer ’et·tên taḥ·te·ḵā ‘al- kis·’e·ḵā hū- yiḇ·neh hab·ba·yiṯ liš·mî
verses.literal: So behold I plan to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God according to what the LORD said to my father . . . David I will put your son on your throne in your place and he will build the house for My Name
verses.literalPt: E eis que eu intento edificar uma casa ao nome do SENHOR meu Deus, como falou o SENHOR a Davi, meu pai, dizendo: Teu filho, que porei em teu lugar no teu trono, ele edificará uma casa ao meu nome.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה צַוֵּה֩ וְיִכְרְתוּ־ לִ֨י אֲרָזִ֜ים מִן־ הַלְּבָנ֗וֹן וַֽעֲבָדַי֙ יִהְי֣וּ עִם־ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ וּשְׂכַ֤ר עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לְךָ֔ כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמֵ֑ר כִּ֣י׀ אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין בָּ֛נוּ אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ לִכְרָת־ עֵצִ֖ים כַּצִּדֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ṣaw·wêh wə·yiḵ·rə·ṯū- lî ’ă·rā·zîm min- hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏay yih·yū ‘im- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ū·śə·ḵar ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ’et·tên lə·ḵā kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tō·mêr kî ’at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tā kî ’ên bā·nū ’îš yō·ḏê·a‘ liḵ·rāṯ- ‘ê·ṣîm kaṣ·ṣi·ḏō·nîm
verses.literal: Now therefore order that cedars of Lebanon be cut down for me My servants will be with your servants and I will pay your servants whatever wages . . . you set for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging . . . as the Sidonians
verses.literalPt: Dá ordem, pois, agora, que do Líbano me cortem cedros, e os meus servos estarão com os teus servos, e eu te darei o salário dos teus servos, conforme a tudo o que disseres; porque bem sabes tu que entre nós ninguém há que saiba cortar a madeira como os sidônios.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֧עַ חִירָ֛ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וַיִּשְׂמַ֣ח מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן לְדָוִד֙ בֵּ֣ן חָכָ֔ם עַל־ הָעָ֥ם הָרָ֖ב הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ḥî·rām ’eṯ- diḇ·rê šə·lō·mōh way·yiś·maḥ mə·’ōḏ way·yō·mer bā·rūḵ Yah·weh hay·yō·wm ’ă·šer nā·ṯan lə·ḏā·wiḏ bên ḥā·ḵām ‘al- hā·‘ām hā·rāḇ haz·zeh
verses.literal: When Hiram received Solomon’s message he rejoiced greatly and said Blessed be the LORD this day He has given David a wise son over this great people
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, ouvindo Hirão as palavras de Salomão, muito se alegrou, e disse: Bendito seja hoje o SENHOR, que deu a Davi um filho sábio sobre este tão grande povo.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח חִירָם֙ אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה לֵאמֹ֔ר שָׁמַ֕עְתִּי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֖חְתָּ אֵלָ֑י אֲנִ֤י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֶפְצְךָ֔ בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים וּבַעֲצֵ֥י בְרוֹשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ḥî·rām ’el- šə·lō·mōh lê·mōr šā·ma‘·tî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ·tā ’ê·lāy ’ă·nî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’eṯ- kāl- ḥep̄·ṣə·ḵā ba·‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm ū·ḇa·‘ă·ṣê ḇə·rō·wō·šîm
verses.literal: Then Hiram sent a reply to Solomon saying I have received your message . . . . . . I will do all you desire regarding the cedar . . . and cypress timber
verses.literalPt: E enviou Hirão a Salomão, dizendo: Ouvi o que me mandaste dizer. Eu farei toda a tua vontade acerca das madeiras de cedro e de cipreste.

verses.original: עֲ֠בָדַי יֹרִ֨דוּ מִן־ הַלְּבָנ֜וֹן יָ֗מָּה וַ֠אֲנִי אֲשִׂימֵ֨ם דֹּבְר֤וֹת בַּיָּם֙ עַֽד־ הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלַ֛י וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥ים שָׁ֖ם וְאַתָּ֣ה תִשָּׂ֑א וְאַתָּה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶת־ חֶפְצִ֔י לָתֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם בֵּיתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay yō·ri·ḏū min- hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn yām·māh wa·’ă·nî ’ă·śî·mêm dō·ḇə·rō·wṯ bay·yām ‘aḏ- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- tiš·laḥ ’ê·lay wə·nip·paṣ·tîm šām wə·’at·tāh ṯiś·śā wə·’at·tāh ta·‘ă·śeh ’eṯ- ḥep̄·ṣî lā·ṯêṯ le·ḥem bê·ṯî
verses.literal: My servants will haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify . . . There I will separate the logs and you can take them away And in exchange, you can meet my needs by providing my household with food
verses.literalPt: Os meus servos as levarão desde o Líbano até ao mar, e eu as farei conduzir em jangadas pelo mar até ao lugar que me designares, e ali as desamarrarei; e tu as tomarás; tu também farás a minha vontade, dando sustento à minha casa.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י חִיר֜וֹם נֹתֵ֣ן לִשְׁלֹמֹ֗ה עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים וַעֲצֵ֥י בְרוֹשִׁ֖ים כָּל־ חֶפְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḥî·rō·wm nō·ṯên liš·lō·mōh ‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm wa·‘ă·ṣê ḇə·rō·wō·šîm kāl- ḥep̄·ṣōw
verses.literal: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar . . . and cypress timber he wanted
verses.literalPt: Assim deu Hirão a Salomão madeira de cedro e madeira de cipreste, conforme a toda a sua vontade.

verses.original: וּשְׁלֹמֹה֩ נָתַ֨ן לְחִירָ֜ם עֶשְׂרִים֩ אֶ֨לֶף כֹּ֤ר חִטִּים֙ מַכֹּ֣לֶת לְבֵית֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים כֹּ֖ר שֶׁ֣מֶן כָּתִ֑ית כֹּֽה־ יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לְחִירָ֖ם שָׁנָ֥ה בְשָׁנָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·lō·mōh nā·ṯan lə·ḥî·rām ‘eś·rîm ’e·lep̄ kōr ḥiṭ·ṭîm mak·kō·leṯ lə·ḇê·ṯōw wə·‘eś·rîm kōr še·men kā·ṯîṯ kōh- yit·tên šə·lō·mōh lə·ḥî·rām šā·nāh ḇə·šā·nāh
verses.literal: - and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 . . . cors of wheat as food for his household as well as 20,000 baths of pure olive oil . . .
verses.literalPt: E Salomão deu a Hirão vinte mil coros de trigo, para sustento da sua casa, e vinte coros de azeite batido; isto dava Salomão a Hirão anualmente.

verses.original: וַיהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן חָכְמָה֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ ל֑וֹ וַיְהִ֣י שָׁלֹ֗ם בֵּ֤ין חִירָם֙ וּבֵ֣ין שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ בְרִ֖ית שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh nā·ṯan ḥāḵ·māh liš·lō·mōh ka·’ă·šer dib·ber- lōw way·hî šā·lōm bên ḥî·rām ū·ḇên šə·lō·mōh way·yiḵ·rə·ṯū ḇə·rîṯ šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom as He had promised him There was peace between Hiram . . . and Solomon and the two of them made a treaty
verses.literalPt: Deu, pois, o SENHOR a Salomão sabedoria, como lhe tinha falado; e houve paz entre Hirão e Salomão, e ambos fizeram acordo.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַל הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה מַ֖ס מִכָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י הַמַּ֔ס שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh mas mik·kāl yiś·rā·’êl way·hî ham·mas šə·lō·šîm ’e·lep̄ ’îš
verses.literal: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force . . . of 30,000 . . . men from all Israel
verses.literalPt: E o rei Salomão fez subir uma leva de gente dentre todo o Israel, e foi a leva de gente trinta mil homens;

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֣ם לְבָנ֗וֹנָה עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ חֲלִיפ֔וֹת חֹ֚דֶשׁ יִהְי֣וּ בַלְּבָנ֔וֹן שְׁנַ֥יִם חֳדָשִׁ֖ים בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַאֲדֹנִירָ֖ם עַל־ הַמַּֽס׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lā·ḥêm lə·ḇā·nō·w·nāh ‘ă·śe·reṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ba·ḥō·ḏeš ḥă·lî·p̄ō·wṯ ḥō·ḏeš yih·yū ḇal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn šə·na·yim ḥo·ḏā·šîm bə·ḇê·ṯōw wa·’ă·ḏō·nî·rām ‘al- ham·mas
verses.literal: He sent them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000 men . . . so that they would spend one month in Lebanon and two months at home And Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor
verses.literalPt: E os enviava ao Líbano, cada mês, dez mil por turno; um mês estavam no Líbano, e dois meses cada um em sua casa; e Adonirão estava sobre a leva de gente.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י לִשְׁלֹמֹ֛ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף נֹשֵׂ֣א סַבָּ֑ל וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֹצֵ֥ב בָּהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî liš·lō·mōh šiḇ·‘îm ’e·lep̄ nō·śê sab·bāl ū·šə·mō·nîm ’e·lep̄ ḥō·ṣêḇ bā·hār
verses.literal: Solomon had 70,000 . . . porters . . . and 80,000 . . . stonecutters in the mountains
verses.literalPt: Tinha também Salomão setenta mil que levavam as cargas, e oitenta mil que talhavam pedras nas montanhas,

verses.original: לְ֠בַד מִשָּׂרֵ֨י הַנִּצָּבִ֤ים לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת הָרֹדִ֣ים בָּעָ֔ם הָעֹשִׂ֖ים בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḇaḏ miś·śā·rê han·niṣ·ṣā·ḇîm liš·lō·mōh ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ hā·rō·ḏîm bā·‘ām hā·‘ō·śîm bam·mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: not including his 3,300 . . . . . . . . . foremen . . . . . . . . . who supervised the workers . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Afora os chefes dos oficiais de Salomão, que estavam sobre aquela obra, três mil e trezentos, os quais davam as ordens ao povo que fazia aquela obra.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ וַיַּסִּעוּ֩ אֲבָנִ֨ים גְּדֹל֜וֹת אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת לְיַסֵּ֥ד הַבָּ֖יִת אַבְנֵ֥י גָזִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw ham·me·leḵ way·yas·si·‘ū ’ă·ḇā·nîm gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm yə·qā·rō·wṯ lə·yas·sêḏ hab·bā·yiṯ ’aḇ·nê ḡā·zîṯ
verses.literal: And the king commanded them to quarry large costly stones to lay the foundation of the temple . . . with dressed stones
verses.literalPt: E mandou o rei que trouxessem pedras grandes, e pedras valiosas, pedras lavradas, para fundarem a casa.

verses.original: וַֽיִּפְסְל֞וּ בֹּנֵ֧י שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה וּבֹנֵ֥י חִיר֖וֹם וְהַגִּבְלִ֑ים וַיָּכִ֛ינוּ הָעֵצִ֥ים וְהָאֲבָנִ֖ים לִבְנ֥וֹת הַבָּֽיִת׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·sə·lū bō·nê šə·lō·mōh ū·ḇō·nê ḥî·rō·wm wə·hag·giḇ·lîm way·yā·ḵî·nū hā·‘ê·ṣîm wə·hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm liḇ·nō·wṯ hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: So Solomon’s and Hiram’s builders along with the Gebalites quarried the stone and prepared the timber and stone for the construction of the temple
verses.literalPt: E as lavraram os edificadores de Hirão, e os giblitas; e preparavam a madeira e as pedras para edificar a casa.
